note: Counts read from the source repository's records, which do not reach the public tree. Each "how" is the rule the count is taken by.

specs.how: directories under specs/ named NNN-slug that carry a spec.md

criteria.how: headings "### AC-<n>" across those spec.md files

gates.how: those directories that carry a gate.sh or gate.mjs

mutation_lines.how: lines naming MUTATION in those gate files

red_records.how: files under specs/*/evidence/ whose name begins "red"

held.how: approval records whose verdict is rejected or whose blocking_findings is above zero

rejected.how: approval records whose verdict is rejected

amendments.how: headings "### A-<spec>-<n>" across the spec.md files
